title: Decade Bow "Scorpion's Clutch"

{{Weapon infobox | type = [[Bow]] | campaign = [[Core]] | image = [[Image:Decade Bow "Scorpion's Clutch".jpg|x350px]]
[[:File:Scorpion's Lust in-game.jpg|View weapon's in-game proportions]] | attribute = [[Marksmanship]] | damagetype = [[Piercing damage]] | bowclass = [[Flatbow]] | unique = yes | icon = Scorpion's Lust }} [[Decade Bow "Scorpion's Clutch"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[flatbow]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]]. ==Stats== :[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]]) :Deals 20% additional damage during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in [[PvP]]. :[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%) :[[Strength]]: 5 (if your rank is lower. No effect in PvP.) :Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend. ==Skin== Uses the same [[skin]] as [[Scorpion's Lust]] and [[Scorpion's Lust (promotional)]]. ==Replica== This item cannot be replicated, as the "+20% damage during Festival Events" mod does not exist outside the unique Decade weapons. ==Notes== *The inherent bonus damage during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]). * Without attribute points invested in Strength, the inherent Strength from this weapon provides 5% base armor penetration with [[attack skill]]s. This can stack with the 20% bonus armor penetration from this weapon, but does not stack with the armor penetration on [[Penetrating Attack]] and [[Sundering Attack]]. {{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this bow's appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}} ==Trivia== *Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20250415|April 15, 2025 update]]. ==Notes== * Other items with this appearance: **{{r}} [[Scorpion's Lust]] **{{r}} [[Scorpion's Lust (promotional)]] ==Gallery== File:Scorpion's Lust front view.jpg|Front view.
